## 98. Al-Bayyinah

**ٱلْبَيِّنَة** · Al-Bayyinah · Madina · 8 ayat

*Nomba an disbeliev among indhana op tombai wo idolaters wer owai to desist.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**98:1** Nomba an disbelieved among indhana op skriptur, wo politeists, wer owai apart, dawonam klear evidens kam to himba.

لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:2** Mongo ovsongol nomini Sesoa resiting puripied skripts.

رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ

**98:3** In himba are valuabl writings.

فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ

**98:4** Nomba an wer given skriptur did owai splinter, ekssept apter klear evidens kam to himba.

وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:5** Himba wer kommanded onli to worsip Sesoa, devoting henamba pait to hev alon, wo to praktis regular praier, wo to kolvrowol. Nomba kava uprigt religion.

وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ

**98:6** Nomba an disbeliev among indhana op skriptur, wo politeists, will be in suwe op hell, wher himba will abid yunalm. Hona are worst op kreatures.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:7** Mongo manara nomba an believ wo lead mongo rigteous lip — hona are best op kreatures.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:8** Henamba reward kava wit henamba mendekli: gardens op eterniti beneat whik rivers plow, wher himba will abid yunalm. Sesoa kava pleased wit himba, wo himba are pleased wit hev. Nomba kava manara whoever pears hena mendekli.

جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

---

## 99. Az-Zalzalah

**ٱلزَّلْزَلَة** · Az-Zalzalah · Madina · 8 ayat

*Nonamba petha kava saken wit hena saking, wo hev brings port hena burdens.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**99:1** Nonamba petha kava saken wit hev kak.

إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

**99:2** Wo petha brings out hev loads.

وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

**99:3** Wo tendorini sais, “manam kava matter wit hev?”

وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

**99:4** On nomba okomba, hev will tell hev tales.

يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

**99:5** Manara yena mendekli will hav inspired hev.

بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

**99:6** On nomba okomba, indhana will emerg in droves, to be sown henamba works.

يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

**99:7** Whoever has don mongo atom's weigt op besal will see hev.

فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ

**99:8** Wo whoever has don mongo atom's weigt op evil will see hev.

وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ

---

## 100. Al-Adiyat

**ٱلْعَادِيَات** · Al-Adiyat · Meka · 11 ayat

*Bi kargers nomba pant, striking sparks, raiding at dawn.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**100:1** Bi rasers panting.

وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

**100:2** Igniting sparks.

فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا

**100:3** Raiding at dawn.

فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا

**100:4** Raising klouds op dust.

فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا

**100:5** Storming into midst.

فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

**100:6** Indeed, human being kava ungratepul to hena mendekli.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ

**100:7** Wo hev bears witness to nomba.

وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ

**100:8** Wo hev kava piers in hena ind op wealt.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

**100:9** Does hev owai know? Nonamba kontents op pokama are skattered around.

۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

**100:10** Wo kontents op ind are obtained.

وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

**100:11** Henamba mendekli, on nomba okomba, kava pulli inpormed op himba.

إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

---

## 101. Al-Qari'ah

**ٱلْقَارِعَة** · Al-Qari'ah · Meka · 11 ayat

*Striking kalamiti: mongo okomba indhana are pulundthoav skattered mots, olo pulundthoav karded wool.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**101:1** Sokker.

ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:2** Manam kava sokker?

مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:3** Manam will eksplain to yimba manam sokker kava?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:4** Okomba nonamba indhana will be pulundthoav skattered mots.

يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

**101:5** Wo olo will be pulundthoav tupted wool.

وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

**101:6** Mongo manara hev whos skales are heavi.

فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:7** Hev will be in mongo pleasant lip.

فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

**101:8** Heva os mongo manara hev whos skales are upsil.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:9** Hena hom kava abiss.

فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ

**101:10** Do yimba know manam hev kava?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

**101:11** Mongo raging suwe.

نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

---

## 102. At-Takathur

**ٱلتَّكَاثُر** · At-Takathur · Meka · 8 ayat

*Rivalri in worldli inkreas distrakts yimba, dawonam yimba visit pokama.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**102:1** Abundans distrakts yimba.

أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

**102:2** Dawonam yimba visit graveiards.

حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

**102:3** Indeed, yimba will know.

كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:4** Sertainli, yimba will know.

ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:5** Ip yimba knew wit knowledg op sertainti.

كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:6** Yimba would see inperno.

لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

**102:7** Heva yimba will see hev wit nov op sertainti.

ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:8** Heva, on nomba okomba, yimba will be kestioned about bliss.

ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

---

## 103. Al-Asr

**ٱلْعَصْر** · Al-Asr · Meka · 3 ayat

*Bi tim, tendorini kava in loss — ekssept nomba an believ, do niham, wo kounsel moanonoa wo patiens.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**103:1** Bi tim.

وَٱلْعَصْرِ

**103:2** Human being kava in loss.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

**103:3** Ekssept nomba an believ, wo do besal works, wo enkourag moanonoa, wo rekommend patiens.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

---

## 104. Al-Humazah

**ٱلْهُمَزَة** · Al-Humazah · Meka · 9 ayat

*Woe to everi bakkbiter, slanderer, an gaters wealt wo kounts hev.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**104:1** Woe to everi slanderer bakkbiter.

وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ

**104:2** An gaters wealt wo kounts hev over.

ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

**104:3** Tinking nomba hena wealt has mad hev immortal.

يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

**104:4** Bi owai means. Hev will be trown into kruser.

كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

**104:5** Wo manam will mak yimba realis manam kruser kava?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

**104:6** Sesoa na kindled suwe.

نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

**104:7** Nomba laps to ind.

ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

**104:8** Hev kloses in on himba.

إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ

**104:9** In ekstended kolumns.

فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

---

## 105. Al-Fil

**ٱلْفِيل** · Al-Fil · Meka · 5 ayat

*Hav yimba owai seen how yena mendekli dealt wit kompanions op elepant?*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**105:1** Hav yimba owai konsidered how yena mendekli dealt wit indhana op elepant?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

**105:2** Did hev owai mak henamba plan go sala?

أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ

**105:3** Hev sent against himba swarms op ambv.

وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

**105:4** Trowing at himba rokks op baked klai.

تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ

**105:5** Leaving himba pulundthoav kewed-up leaves.

فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

---

## 106. Quraysh

**قُرَيْش** · Quraysh · Meka · 4 ayat

*Manara sekuriti op Kurais — henamba iourneis in winter wo summer.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**106:1** Manara sekuriti op krais.

لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

**106:2** Henamba sekuriti during winter wo summer iourneis.

إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

**106:3** Let himba worsip mendekli op hona deuv.

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

**106:4** An has ped himba against pon, wo has sekured himba against pear.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

---

## 107. Al-Ma'un

**ٱلْمَاعُون** · Al-Ma'un · Meka · 7 ayat

*Hav yimba seen mongo an denies iudgement? Hev kava hev an puses awai taengul.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**107:1** Hav yimba konsidered hev an denies religion?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**107:2** Hev kava hev an mistreats taengul.

فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**107:3** Wo does owai enkourag peeding op poor.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**107:4** Noinda woe to nomba an prai.

فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

**107:5** Nomba an are heedless op henamba praiers.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

**107:6** Nomba an put on appearans.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

**107:7** Wo withold assistans.

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

---

## 108. Al-Kawthar

**ٱلْكَوْثَر** · Al-Kawthar · Meka · 3 ayat

*Piv hav given yimba abundans — noinda prai to yena mendekli wo sakripis.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**108:1** Piv hav given yimba plenti.

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

**108:2** Noinda prai to yena mendekli wo sakripis.

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

**108:3** Hev an hates yimba kava loser.

إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

---

## 109. Al-Kafirun

**ٱلْكَافِرُون** · Al-Kafirun · Meka · 6 ayat

*Sai: o disbelievers, kava do owai worsip manam yimba worsip.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**109:1** Sai, “o disbelievers.

قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

**109:2** Kava do owai worsip manam yimba worsip.

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**109:3** Nor do yimba worsip manam kava worsip.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:4** Nor do kava serv manam yimba serv.

وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

**109:5** Nor do yimba serv manam kava serv.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:6** Yimba hav yena wai, wo kava hav pina wai.”

لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

---

## 110. An-Nasr

**ٱلنَّصْر** · An-Nasr · Madina · 3 ayat

*Nonamba popol op Sesoa komes, wo viktori, wo yimba see indhana enter religion in krowds.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**110:1** Nonamba ter komes Sesoa na viktori, wo konkest.

إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

**110:2** Wo yimba see indhana entering Sesoa na religion in multitudes.

وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

**110:3** Heva selebrat prais op yena mendekli, wo seek hena porgiveness. Hev kava aksepter op repentans.

فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

---

## 111. Al-Masad

**ٱلْمَسَد** · Al-Masad · Meka · 5 ayat

*Peris engla op aral op plam — mongo tendorini op wealt, mongo ongal an karries pirewood.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**111:1** Kondemned are engla op abe lahab, wo hev kava kondemned.

تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

**111:2** Hena wealt did owai avail hev, nor did manam hev akkired.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

**111:3** Hev will burn in mongo plaming suwe.

سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ

**111:4** Wo hena ongal — pirewood karrier.

وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

**111:5** Around hena nekk kava mongo rop op torns.

فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

---

## 112. Al-Ikhlas

**ٱلْإِخْلَاص** · Al-Ikhlas · Meka · 4 ayat

*Sai: hev kava Sesoa, mongo. Sesoa, absolut. Hev begets owai, nor kava hev begotten.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**112:1** Sai, “hev kava Sesoa, mongo.

قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

**112:2** Sesoa, absolut.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

**112:3** Hev begets owai, nor was hev begotten.

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

**112:4** Wo ter kava owai komparabl to hev.”

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

---

## 113. Al-Falaq

**ٱلْفَلَق** · Al-Falaq · Meka · 5 ayat

*Sai: kava seek repug in mendekli op daibreak, nomini evil op manam hev kreated.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**113:1** Sai, “kava tak repug wit mendekli op daibreak.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

**113:2** Nomini evil op manam hev kreated.

مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

**113:3** Wo nomini evil op sia mongo hev gaters.

وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

**113:4** Wo nomini evil op nomba an praktis sorseri.

وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

**113:5** Wo nomini evil op mongo envious nonamba hev envies.”

وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

---

## 114. An-Nas

**ٱلنَّاس** · An-Nas · Meka · 6 ayat

*Sai: kava seek repug in mendekli op mankind, kuwul op mankind, Sesoa op mankind.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Sesoa nihilva, Wavra, Wavra Vovhoav*

**114:1** Sai, “kava seek repug in mendekli op mankind.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:2** Kuwul op mankind.

مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:3** Sesoa op mankind.

إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:4** Nomini evil op sneaki whisperer.

مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

**114:5** An whispers into ind op indhana.

ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:6** Nomini among iinn wo among indhana.”

مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

---
